assumptions: A classical, globally specified black-hole spacetime formed by collapse.
A quantum matter field on that fixed curved background.
Well-defined asymptotic in and out mode decompositions.
Hadamard/physically admissible state conditions sufficient for renormalized observables.
Negligible backreaction during the particle-creation calculation.
mechanism.statement: The exponential relation between horizon-adapted and asymptotic null coordinates produces nonzero beta Bogoliubov coefficients. The in vacuum therefore contains outgoing out-particles with an asymptotically thermal spectrum at temperature T_H = ħκ/(2πk_B c), modified by greybody transmission factors.
